symptom: After restarting the game, Video settings in the main menu appear reset/out of sync and the UI immediately behaves as if unapplied changes exist.

root_cause.behavior: When true, Activate calls AC_PC_NiceSettingsComponent.Load and Apply Settings.
root_cause.v18_5_change: Both WB_T3_SettingsMenu.Activate call sites in WB_T3_MainMenu were forced to False.
root_cause.consequence: Manual settings-open became fast, but the separate startup/post-show settings synchronization was also disabled.

rejected_hypothesis: Localized Borderless/Fullscreen/Windowed strings were inspected but not proven to be technical dispatch identifiers in the NiceSettings save/apply path.
